subject: reasoning
question:
A, B, C, D, E, F, and G are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Only 2 people sit between C and F when counted from the right of C. A and D are immediate neighbours of G. E sits to the immediate left of B. Only 1 person sits between E and D when counted from the right of D.

Who is sitting to the immediate right of G?
solution:
According to the given information,

1) Only 2 people sit between C and F when counted from the right of C. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/71d381665716f955214d7de60774c6d6a7e50a35accaad6b0fea183f50ba19d9.png] 

2) A and D are immediate neighbours of G.

3) Only 1 person sits between
